title: Conformal Cascade: Distribution-Free Accuracy Guarantees for Multi-Tier LLM Inference
why: Jul 2026; distribution-free accuracy guarantee for accept-or-defer cheap-tier decisions on multiple-choice (classification-shaped) tasks — closest frontier mechanism to a guaranteed swap gate

title: C3PO: Optimized Large Language Model Cascades with Probabilistic Cost Constraints for Reasoning
why: Nov 2025 (NeurIPS 2025); label-free cascade built from unlabeled outputs, using regret relative to the strongest model plus conformal cost bounds — matches using the incumbent model's past answers as reference

title: Prediction-Powered Inference Across Many Tasks for AI Evaluation & Social Science Research
why: May 2026 (ICML 2026); multi-task PPI that pools scarce human labels across many tasks — directly relevant to certifying many migrated call sites at once with few labels per site

title: Conformal Arbitrage: Risk-Controlled Balancing of Competing Objectives in Language Models
why: Jun 2025 (NeurIPS 2025); conformal-risk-controlled threshold between a primary and a fallback model with finite-sample guarantees — template for a risk-controlled cheap/incumbent switch

title: SMART: Automatically Scaling Down Language Models with Accuracy Guarantees for Reduced Processing Fees
why: 2024; direct precedent baseline — picks the cheapest LLM whose accuracy against the reference best LLM meets a tolerance, using binomial confidence intervals; the swap gate must beat it

title: Trust or Escalate: LLM Judges with Provable Guarantees for Human Agreement
why: 2024/ICLR 2025; cascaded selective evaluation with a provable human-agreement guarantee via fixed-sequence testing — the baseline for risk control on cheap-then-escalate decisions

title: Active Statistical Inference
why: 2024; foundational method for budgeted, uncertainty-guided label collection with valid CIs — the backbone for choosing which production calls get human labels
